scope: Seven scheduled or automatically triggered GitHub workflows not covered by the initial external-deployment/subscriber quarantine.

evidence: Can assign unassigned issues and PRs when COPILOT_ASSIGNEE is configured
findings.current_limitation: Prior run reported COPILOT_ASSIGNEE unset; this does not remove the capability.

evidence: Resolver comments and closes a matching issue when the latest workflow run succeeds
findings.risk: Closes issues without per-issue human approval.

evidence: scripts/daily_digest.py reads web/signal_accuracy.json and can publish the legacy 45.5% / 772-of-1697 aggregate
findings.risk: Can republish a metric that PR #1572 correctly identifies as unvalidated until the prediction-integrity correction is merged.

evidence: scripts/self_schedule.py creates issues and adds the barrot-task label
findings.risk: Creates external issues and labels from automated source-gap detection; downstream task routing must be reviewed.

evidence: Commits and pushes two research outputs directly to main
findings.risk: Autonomous main mutation conflicts with the no-main-write preservation policy.

evidence: scripts/gumroad_metrics.py prints the raw product API response to job logs before extracting aggregate fields
findings.risk: Unnecessary raw API logging requires privacy/output minimization review; this is not evidence that purchaser emails were returned or exposed.

evidence: Commits enrichment outputs directly to main
findings.risk: Autonomous main mutation without a separate reviewed artifact-promotion boundary.

additional_observations: barrot-pr-automerge.yml on main is already a read-only fail-closed notice; the comment in barrot-autonomous-resolver.yml that PRs are picked up and merged is stale and inaccurate.

Manual-only main writers remain outside this quarantine: financial-data-refresh.yml, knowledge-signal-cycle.yml, knowledge-signal-cycle-btc.yml, self-benchmark.yml, entity-relations.yml, research-topics.yml and subagent-spawn.yml. They were not dispatched.

barrot-agent.yml remains an issue-label/manual task runner with contents, pull-request and issue write permissions; its event-sender condition restricts label-triggered execution to Barrot-Agent or the repository owner. It requires a separate authorization and branch-only review.
The current main advanced from PR #1573's base only by 21169aa3, which changes ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json. None of the seven added workflow paths overlaps that main change.
No workflow was dispatched; no issue was created, closed, commented on or assigned; no repository main write or external API action was performed.
proposed_controls: Replace each of the seven workflows with a disabled, empty-permission, no-secret, no-schedule fail-closed notice.
Add regression tests asserting that schedules, upstream triggers, credentials, write permissions and mutation commands remain absent.
Keep original behavior in Git history; do not delete the scripts or historical data.
residuals: Manual-only main writers remain to be reviewed separately.
Protected GitHub Environment approval configuration is not verified through current integration permissions.
Disabling a workflow in this PR does not affect current main until approved and merged.
